scope: Repository-visible production website, static deployment, Cloudflare Web Analytics, GitHub Actions ingestion and outbound links. Account-dashboard retention and contractual details remain operator-controlled.

public_client.rendering: Static HTML, CSS, images and JavaScript served from the same origin through Cloudflare Worker assets.
browser_state: URL query parameters and fragment for catalog and Finder state
notes: History API changes do not send a request by themselves.
Reloading, opening or sharing a filtered URL can expose its path and query parameters to Cloudflare request handling and logs.
Finder parameters describe product preferences such as placement, capacity, dimensions, electrical supply and budget. The Finder does not ask health questions or request an account.

data: host, path and possible query parameters
services.retention: Not configured in this repository; verify the Cloudflare account and product settings.
services.region_or_transfer: Not established by repository code; verify the Cloudflare agreement, DPA and account configuration.

services.trigger: Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon on a page visit
data: URL and request metadata needed for the analytics report
services.retention: Controlled by the Cloudflare Web Analytics account and product settings; not configured in this repository.
services.region_or_transfer: Controlled by Cloudflare; verify the zone's contractual entity, DPA and applicable transfer terms.

services.trigger: Git update received by the connected Cloudflare build configuration
data: Source tree and versioned JSON content
build commands, dependency metadata and generated static output
purpose: retain deployment history for rollback and diagnosis
services.storage_in_repository: Build configuration is versioned. Build logs, generated deployment artifacts and deployment history are held by Cloudflare rather than committed to the repository.
services.retention: Cloudflare build-log and deployment-history retention are account settings and must be verified.
services.region_or_transfer: The operator has connected the GitHub repository to Cloudflare, but contractual entity, processing location and transfer terms are not established by repository code.

data: exact merchant product URLs and affiliate tracking URLs
services.storage_in_repository: Only sanitized reports and reviewed catalog changes. The secret feed-list URL and raw feed response are not committed by the implemented workflow.
services.retention: Raw responses exist in runner process memory for the workflow run. GitHub workflow-log and artifact retention are account settings and must be verified.
services.region_or_transfer: Not established by repository code; verify the Awin and GitHub account agreements and settings.

services.trigger: Repository push, pull request or manual workflow dispatch
services.retention: Repository history persists until deliberately changed. Workflow-log retention is an account setting and must be verified.
services.region_or_transfer: Not established by repository code; verify the GitHub plan, DPA and account settings.

services.trigger: User deliberately opens a link labelled Affiliate link
data: publisher ID contained in the tracking URL
ordinary HTTP request metadata such as IP address, referrer and user-agent
services.storage_in_repository: The approved static tracking URL is versioned with the offer; click events are not collected by Select Your Sauna code.
services.retention: Controlled by Awin and the merchant after the click; not configured in this repository.
services.region_or_transfer: Controlled by Awin and the merchant; verify program terms and privacy documents before US publication.

services.trigger: User opens a merchant, manufacturer, documentation or authority source link
data: Ordinary HTTP request metadata, including possible referrer, IP address and user-agent
purpose: Open the selected product or evidence source
services.retention: Controlled by the selected website; not configured in this repository.

services.trigger: User opens the mailto link and sends an email through their own email client
services.retention: Mailbox and routing retention are outside the repository and must be documented from the actual email configuration.
services.region_or_transfer: Email-routing destination and providers are not evidenced in the repository.

negative_findings: No first-party analytics or advertising SDK; Cloudflare Web Analytics is an active hosting-layer service
No Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager
No analytics, marketing or personalization cookie code
No browser fetch, XMLHttpRequest or sendBeacon call in app or lib
No account, login, checkout, payment or server-backed contact form
No geolocation, camera, microphone or payment browser permission
No embedded third-party frame, font or image; the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon is the only explicitly allowed third-party script host
No US affiliate offer or live US tracking destination in the current dataset

implemented_controls.source: data/us/publication.json routes_enabled plus US_ROUTES_ENABLED environment restriction
implemented_controls.state: enabled for the reviewed first-wave release
enabled for the reviewed first-wave release

implemented_controls.source: data/us/publication.json affiliate_links_enabled plus US_AFFILIATE_LINKS_DISABLED emergency switch

implemented_controls.state: connect-src remains same-origin for automatic Cloudflare RUM; scripts allow only the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon; frames disabled

proposed_controls.reason: Do not add granular click references until a non-personal event schema and retention purpose are approved.
A future form needs a processor, abuse control, retention rule and published privacy text. The current mailto path needs no website backend.
A hosted US preview would need a documented access-control service. The current protected preview remains offline.

account_checks_required: Cloudflare request-log, Web Analytics, bot/security and retention settings (Web Analytics confirmed active by operator)
Cloudflare Git integration and build-log retention
GitHub Actions log retention and authorized repository users
Awin US program terms, tracking parameters, reporting retention and international transfers
Mailbox destination, Cloudflare Email Routing state, email provider and message retention
